text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While in the cafeteria, I overheard Sakura 
Chiyono O asking someone for advice.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“—And so, I'm going to go visit 
Maruzen-san's house sometime soon!”

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! You live on your own, right, 
Maruzen-san?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So you're saying you're troubled over what 
souvenir to bring on the day?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
That's right. As the saying goes, 
'Familiarity breeds politeness, and mochi 
holds red bean paste.'

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: There's a continuation to that proverb...?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
In any case, Maruzen-san is quite mature, 
so wouldn't a more understated souvenir be 
best?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, you have quite a playful side to 
you, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
The other day, someone recommended their 
favorite music to me, but they gave it to 
me on a cassette tape, so I couldn't 
listen to it.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Your favorite music...! I would love to 
listen to it whenever I visit your 
home...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
By the way, my impression of Maruzen-san 
is that she's super cool with 
overwhelmingly fast speed!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"That's true. Someday, I want to pull up 
alongside that back, and then pull ahead."

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Maruzen-san seems to love fast things, so 
maybe we should think along those lines?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
A souvenir that feels "fast"... Hmm, what 
could that be?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's better if it's handmade. I make 
Japanese sweets quite often, after all.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Well then, well then, how about some 
stylishly shaped mizu-yokan!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
It might be hard to imagine what a 'sleek 
and sharp' shape looks like, but...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
For example, what do you think about 
making it look like a supercar?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see! Maybe we could make nerikiri shaped 
like supercars!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Then, for the souvenirs, handmade Japanese 
sweets—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, but Maruzen-san, you're always 
talking about sweets with foreign-sounding 
names, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: True, like tiramisu or nata de coco.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Could it be that... she doesn't really 
like traditional Japanese sweets...?"

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... I thought it was a good idea, 
though.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
My eyes met Sakura Chiyono O and the 
others as they racked their brains for 
ideas.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
U-Um! Excuse me! What kind of souvenirs 
make adults happy? Are Japanese sweets a 
bad idea?
choice_data_list:
As long as it's from the heart, anything 
goes!

Maybe you should try to match their 
interests.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I understand... what you're saying! I'll 
give it my all with the Japanese sweet I'm 
most confident in!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Both your skill at making wagashi and your 
admiration for Maruzen-san are truly 
exceptional, Chiyono O-senpai. She's sure 
to be delighted.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! Could I ask you to do 
a taste test for me next time?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Of course. I'm looking forward to it.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'll help too! If you ever need a taste 
tester, call on me anytime!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
How reassuring! I'll do my best to make 
both of you proud!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I see...! In that case, I will try making 
Western sweets this time!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
If it's you, Chiyono O-senpai, I'm sure 
your Western pastries will turn out 
delicious too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. ...Um, the things 
Maruzen-san often talks about are 
tiramisu, nata de coco, and—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: It looks like they like Italian food too!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Italian food doesn't quite seem like a 
Western pastry, but...
